description: NetBird: a WireGuard mesh VPN with SSO, access control and routing peers. Management (with built-in sign-in), signal, relay and the dashboard on the bundled PostgreSQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

A self-hosted VPN: NetBird (WireGuard mesh with single sign-on, access policies and routing peers) on a highly available PostgreSQL (a 3-member Patroni cluster that fails over on its own). All component images are QuenchWorks-hardened, nonroot, CVE-gated, pinned by digest and cosign-signed.
